enter your API key in the Authorize part
Pumble maintains a native MCP (Model Context Protocol) server hosted directly at pumble.com, helping you connect your workspace to your AI agent of choice.
The rate limit is up to 1000 requests per minute per user.

result.notes: API requires installing a free "API addon" in the workspace, then any member can self-generate keys via /api-keys generate or the API panel; no plan restriction or approval step found. REST API is small (send/reply/delete messages, reactions, create channel, list channels/DMs — ~9 actions per Composio). Pumble also documents a first-party MCP server (endpoint on pumble.com, auth via x-app-token header) for Claude/Gemini/Codex clients, described on a marketing/learn page rather than the core developer docs — treat mcp.status confidence as moderate since it wasn't cross-confirmed in a formal MCP registry.
result.one_liner: Pumble is a team chat/messaging app offering a self-serve REST API (via an installable API addon) plus a first-party MCP server for connecting AI agents to workspaces.
